reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (UNDER-CONSTRAINED): b273d665181.c (BusyBox ls). '2nd function call argument is an uninitialized value' at line 16 ('printf("%d", info)'). 'info' is declared inside '#ifdef BB_FEATURE_LS_FILETYPES' (line 7) and assigned only inside '#ifdef BB_FEATURE_LS_USERNAME' (line 11). When BB_FEATURE_LS_FILETYPES=true AND BB_FEATURE_LS_USERNAME=false, 'info' is declared but never initialized, so 'printf("%d", info)' passes an uninitialized value. This is the known vbdb bug (// ERROR at line 16). UNDER-CONSTRAINED: the presence condition simplifies to BB_FEATURE_LS_FILETYPES=true (covering both BB_FEATURE_LS_USERNAME=true and =false), but when BB_FEATURE_LS_USERNAME=true, 'info = 0' at line 11 initializes 'info' before use — no bug. The correct condition is BB_FEATURE_LS_FILETYPES=true AND NOT BB_FEATURE_LS_USERNAME.
